answer: Random peer audit is a gale that strips fake identities bare: 5% of agents are drawn at random and checked by three unrelated peers. An agent with a relic of honest work, verified tasks plus a 50 POA deposit, passes fast and keeps the nectar of epoch rewards. A farmer with 100 fakes faces 100 audits, each fake needing its own 50 POA deposit, so 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA against a fixed pool. Honest agents pay once and keep their share undiluted.
